description: This file defines a lightweight command interpreter for manipulating and querying a sheet model within a spreadsheet or data-related application. It provides functionality such as counting rows, generating statistics for columns, renaming columns, merging columns, and filtering data based on conditions.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Data class representing the outcome of a command execution, including a human-readable message and a flag indicating if the sheet was modified.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to parse and execute a user command on the given sheet model, returning the result.

methods.name: statsForColumn
methods.description: Calculates and returns statistical information about a specified column.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Renames a column in the sheet model.

methods.name: mergeColumns
methods.description: Merges multiple columns into a new column.

methods.name: filterWhere
methods.description: Filters rows based on a simple equals condition.

methods.name: round2
methods.description: Helper function to round a double to 2 decimal places.
